description: Phase C — Normal continuation: Loop clip with sectionBehavior=Normal keeps cycling past the break. 16-frame PNG sequence (30fps source, 30fps timeline) extended to 200 timeline frames; section break at timeline frame 8. With Locked, the timeline-derived path would freeze the source frame at 8 (timeline frame 8 / 30fps * 30fps = source 8). With Normal+Loop, SectionScheduler seeds ClipPlaybackPhase=8 and advances it each at-break tick, so by the end of the at-break wait the source phase has drifted well past 8 -- mediaFrame is no longer 8. Asserts mediaFrame is NOT 8 (with a small tolerance) -- this is the differentiator vs. section_locked_clip.json, which asserts the same setup with sectionBehavior=Locked stays at 8.
